description:
Watch a pure white gyrfalcon unleash its speed high in the snowy Alps. 🦅❄️ The falcon folds its wings into a fast hunting stoop and drops hard toward a running ptarmigan. At the last second, the ptarmigan jinks away and escapes as the gyrfalcon overshoots.

A dramatic close-up of speed, precision and the split-second reactions of two incredible mountain birds.

#Gyrfalcon #Ptarmigan #BirdsOfPrey #Wildlife #NatureDocumentary
